run.script:
#!/bin/zsh -l
set -e

# $1 = dossier du .tex (ici: doc/src)
# $2 = chemin du .tex (ici: doc/src/TKZdoc-elements-main.tex)
cd "$1" || exit 1
mkdir -p build

name="$(basename "${2%.*}")"        # -> TKZdoc-elements-main
pdf_build="build/$name.pdf"          # -> build/TKZdoc-elements-main.pdf
pdf_final="../tkz-elements.pdf"      # -> doc/tkz-elements.pdf (un niveau au-dessus de src)

# 1ère passe
/Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -shell-escape -synctex=1 \
  -output-directory=build "$2" || true

# makeindex si besoin
if [[ -f "build/$name.idx" ]]; then
  /Library/TeX/texbin/makeindex -q -o "build/$name.ind" "build/$name.idx" || true
fi

# 2ème passe
/Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -shell-escape -synctex=1 \
  -output-directory=build "$2" || true

# Copier le PDF final dans doc/
# cp "$pdf_build" "$pdf_final"

# Ouvrir le PDF final dans Skim
/usr/bin/open -a /Applications/Skim.app "$pdf_build"

# Nettoyer le build local (doc/src/build)
# rm -rf build

exit 0
